BM25 filter with very high threshold filters out all pages

```typescript title="WebAssembly"
import { WasmContentFilterKind, WasmCrawlConfig, WasmSsrfPolicy, crawl, createEngine } from "@xberg-io/crawlberg-wasm";
async function main() {
  const engineConfig = WasmCrawlConfig.default();
  engineConfig.bm25Query = "quantum physics";
  engineConfig.bm25Threshold = 100.0;
  engineConfig.contentFilter = WasmContentFilterKind.Bm25;
  engineConfig.maxDepth = 1;
  engineConfig.ssrf = (() => { const _u0 = WasmSsrfPolicy.default(); _u0.denyPrivate = false; return _u0; })();
  const engine = createEngine(engineConfig);
  const url = "https://example.com";
  const result = await crawl(engine, url);
  console.log(result.pages.length);
}

void main();
```
